title: The Wrong Room
author: Felix Eastwick
blurb: Ansel Winterbourne, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
